shortDescription: Manage system management routes on a BIG-IP

options.name: gateway
options.description: Specifies the system forwards packets to the destination through the gateway with the specified IP address.

options.name: name
options.description: Specifies the name of the management route.

options.name: network
options.description: The subnet and netmask for the route. To specify the route is the default route for the system, provide the value C(default). Only one C(default) entry is allowed. This parameter cannot be changed after it is set. Therefore, if you do need to change it, you must delete it and create a new route.

options.name: partition
options.description: Device partition to manage resources on.

options.name: provider
options.description: A dict object containing connection details.

options.name: state
options.description: When C(present), ensures the resource exists. When C(absent), ensures the resource is removed.
